source_contract.status: retrospective existing-production analysis; declared before this aggregate, not before target reveal
source_contract.physical_measure: P_lambda proportional to Bernoulli(p) exp(lambda S)

controls.meaning: empirical linear source projection with intercept, refit per orientation in every aligned delete-one; not exact fixed-K or RG thermal centering

source_contract.uncertainty: pooled sample covariance with denominator samples-1, same batch omitted in both directions, retain joint output covariance and all delete-one vectors

rng_correction.actual_key: seed XOR splitmix64(N) XOR splitmix64(replica+c1) XOR splitmix64(site+c2)
rng_correction.interpretation: N is an explicit domain separator; sizes do not share the same site uniforms. Same-N orientations share all uniforms. Different N blocks are treated as independent under the ordinary domain-separated PRNG model; a shared seed/counter interval alone does not prove cross-N dependence.
rng_correction.aggregation: report both sizes and a nominal two-size joint zero statistic for the fixed raw and controlled readouts; derived views are not independent votes

limits: no E_top-times-cluster moment in this archive
N85 is not N130 or another dyadic norm4 generation
no new sample, replay, simulation, server or test suite
this is source response, not a new field count or energy identification
floating-point Gram arithmetic is not an exact rational certificate
source_contract.delivery: same Draft PR267; repository script, JSON and technical Markdown report

definitions.primary_source: S=(c_blackNN+c_whiteMatching)/N, identical raw definition in both geometries
definitions.auxiliary_sources: clock/full empirical covariance projections fitted separately by geometry and refitted in each delete-one; neither span includes q or E
definitions.E: q squared, with q in {-1,0,1}; the motif E_edges is not this observable
definitions.physical_tangent: P proportional to Bernoulli(p) exp(lambda*S_mode+h(lambda)*q), h_prime(0)=-Cov(q,S_mode)/Var(q), holds mean q fixed to first order; rank-one probability derivative is -C

uncertainty: 100 aligned delete-one batches per N; omit same batch in both directions and refit all source projections; full output covariance retained; six correlated nominal two-N zero summaries are not pooled as six independent findings
rng_boundary: counter_uniform includes splitmix64(N); different N blocks use the ordinary N-domain-separated PRNG independence assumption, while same-N orientations and derived views remain paired
coupling_boundary: reported C and its H4 contrast are marginal responses invariant to cross-geometry cyclic coupling; that coupling still determines paired sampling covariance; missing cross-orientation E Gram entries are not fabricated
interpretation_boundary: clock/full compensation and subsequent q holding are sequential; adding the q counterterm need not keep the original control means fixed. Nonzero C distinguishes a pure q tangent only at first order in this finite topological marginal, not an independent continuum field or universal operator
